svg.aria-label: Three nodes, A, B and C, reach the barrier named start at different times, with parties = 3. Each records its arrival as barriers/start/ followed by its learner ID and polls the listing of that prefix. A arrives first and waits; B arrives next and waits; their polls see one key, then two. C arrives, lists three keys and passes at once; A and B pass on their next poll. All three train from the same moment.
svg.text: C arrives: 3 of 3, the barrier opens
Each node records its arrival once and polls the listing: C sees three keys and passes, A and B pass on their next poll.
Arrivals are never removed, so a node that reaches start after the barrier opened passes at once.
